caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, light background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a monochromatic appearance. It has a bulbous, vertically fluted body that tapers upwards into a narrow neck and slightly flared rim. A single, curving handle attaches from the neck to the upper body of the pitcher. The base is wide, rounded, and circular, providing stability to the vessel. Light reflections and shadows are illustrated on the surface of the pitcher, emphasizing its glossy material and three-dimensional shape. No other objects, patterns, or colors are present in the drawing, and the background is uniformly pale with no texture or detailing. The artist’s signature appears in small writing at the bottom left corner.
title: Cruet
